fusions.name: Long-Held Lunge
fusions.desc: A sudden lunge out of stillness that deals 30 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at its full reach of 7 tiles. It always lands as a critical hit and leaves the target [Soaked] for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Sudden Surfacing
fusions.desc: Bursts up from the water, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each back 3 tiles. You regain 10 health.

fusions.name: Sitting Damp
fusions.desc: Increases your health recovery by 50% for 15 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Coiled Calm
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
